lines: Your stats are weak. Your potential is unknown.
Complete your daily quests, grow stronger, defeat your weaknesses, and evolve into the strongest version of yourself.
intro.style: typewriter, one line at a time, blue glow, soft system chime; tap to skip; button 'ACCEPT' at the end
intro.show: first launch only; replayable from Settings

onboarding_after_intro: Choose mode: Normal (8 blocks) or Easy (6 blocks)
before_day_1: [ SYSTEM ] The Gate opens in {days} days. Prepare yourself.
daily_quest_arrived:
[ SYSTEM ] Daily Quest has arrived: Preparation to Become Strong.
[ WARNING ] Failure to complete the quest will result in a penalty.
all_clear: [ SYSTEM ] All daily quests cleared. Bonus awarded.
penalty: [ SYSTEM ] You failed to complete the daily quest. Penalty applied: {xp} XP.
rank_up: [ SYSTEM ] Rank increased. You are now {rank}-Rank: {title}.
level_up: [ SYSTEM ] LEVEL UP. You are now Level {level}.
raid_start: [ SYSTEM ] Boss Raid initiated. Duration: 3 hours. Do not retreat.
raid_clear: [ SYSTEM ] Raid complete. Reward: Monarch's Leisure Gate ({minutes} min).
final_day: [ SYSTEM ] Day 45. The Monarch's Eve. Rest well, Player.
